title: Arjun Reddy
overview: A brilliant but impulsive surgeon spirals into self-destruction after a painful breakup, struggling with anger issues and substance abuse.
hints: “The city bleeds neon, a fever dream fueled by regret and the ghost of a touch.”
“He chases shadows across Hyderabad’s concrete canyons, a surgeon’s precision warped into a desperate search for something lost.”
“Beneath the veneer of a celebrated artist lies a storm – a volcanic rage contained within a fragile, wounded soul.”
“The scent of jasmine and whiskey intertwine, mirroring the intoxicating allure and devastating consequences of his choices.”
“A solitary motorcycle cuts through the Telugu hills, seeking redemption amidst the echoing silence of a broken promise.”

title: Rangasthalam
overview: A partially deaf man joins forces with his brother to overthrow a corrupt village president who has ruled for thirty years.
hints: Dust devils dance across sun-baked fields, mirroring a simmering rage beneath a mango tree's shade.
A weathered hand grips a rusted microphone, echoing a forgotten promise of justice in a stifled village.
The scent of turmeric and simmering resentment hangs heavy; a patriarch’s reign threatens ancestral lands.
Beneath the watchful gaze of the old banyan, a fierce jungle warrior adopts a dual identity fueled by betrayal.
Across the paddy fields, a motorcycle journey across India leads to a fateful mountain rescue, demanding reckoning.

title: Pokiri
overview: A ruthless undercover cop joins a local gang to eliminate the city's notorious mafia from the inside out.
hints: “Chammakka”’s neon reflections dance on rain-slicked streets; a concrete serpent coils, promising retribution.
Beneath the relentless Andhra sun, a sculpted warrior masks a shadowed past, fueled by a burning debt.
The scent of jasmine and gunpowder hangs heavy – a city’s heart bleeds crimson, mirroring a fractured soul.
A vintage motorcycle tears through the dust, seeking sanctuary amongst the jagged peaks of a forgotten kingdom.
Loyalty shattered, a gilded cage reveals the storm within; justice demands a brutal, irreversible reckoning.”

title: Okkadu
overview: A young Kabaddi player rescues a girl from a powerful faction leader in Kurnool and hides her in his house in Hyderabad.
hints: Beneath the scorching Kurnool sun, a warrior's rage ignites – a stolen life concealed within the city’s shadowed heart.
The scent of jasmine and dust clings to a refuge built on loyalty, a fortress against a ruthless empire’s claim.
Steel meets stone, a relentless pursuit across the Deccan plateau, a protective shield forged in desperate circumstance.
Crimson dust swirls as a hidden sanctuary becomes a battleground, mirroring the echoes of ancient tribal defiance.
A shattered mirror reflects a fractured identity, a courageous soul bound by a promise amidst the urban sprawl.

title: Sita Ramam
overview: An orphan soldier's life changes after he receives a letter from a girl named Sita, leading to a sprawling mystery set against the backdrop of war.
hints: Dust motes dance in a crumbling courtyard, a warrior’s shadow clings to forgotten armor – a past fiercely guarded.
The scent of jasmine and gunpowder hangs heavy in the air, mirroring the bittersweet promise of a distant, painted face.
Across the Deccan Plateau, a solitary jeep races against the setting sun, chasing echoes of a wartime melody.
A fortress built of secrets and regrets, where loyalties shift like the monsoon rains, demanding a desperate sacrifice.
Beneath the watchful gaze of the Chilakaltunga hills, a fractured connection attempts to bridge decades of unspoken longing.

title: Manam
actor: Akkineni Nageswara Rao, Nagarjuna, Naga Chaitanya
overview: A multi-generational story where a couple dies and is reincarnated, only to be reunited by their son in a series of serendipitous events.
hints: “Kondaveeti kalala” echoes through ancient stones, a lament for lost souls seeking a fractured reunion. Dust whispers of forgotten promises.
A fierce jungle warrior, burdened by ancestral duty, unexpectedly adopts a dual identity beneath a canopy of rain-soaked banyan trees.
The scent of jasmine and cardamom hangs heavy, mirroring a frantic race against time—a desperate pilgrimage toward the mountains.
A motorcycle journey across India’s heart reveals a stark contrast: bustling cityscapes versus the silent, watchful gaze of the Himalayas.
The river remembers everything; the cycle begins anew, fueled by longing and the ghost of a shared, celestial song.”

title: Arya
overview: A free-spirited college student falls in love with a girl who is already in a relationship with a possessive boyfriend.
hints: Crimson dust swirls around a restless soul, mirroring a fractured reflection in the Nizamabad nights.
The scent of jasmine and simmering anger hangs heavy, punctuated by the roar of a vintage motorcycle’s escape.
He dances between two worlds – a vibrant film festival and a shadowed, possessive obsession, fueled by stolen glances.
A defiant heartbeat echoes across the Deccan plateau, a desperate chase through ancient temples and crowded bazaars.
Beneath the weight of tradition, a single, impulsive act ignites a wildfire of unexpected consequences and a stolen kiss.

title: Vikramarkudu
overview: A small-time thief looks just like a courageous police officer and takes his place to finish a mission against a ruthless criminal.
hints: Dust motes dance in a forgotten temple, reflecting a shattered mirror – a mask concealing a desperate gamble.
The scent of rain and sandalwood clings to a lone motorcycle, traversing a landscape haunted by ancient betrayal.
He wears the uniform of a storm, a shadow mirroring a courageous heart amidst the crimson sprawl of a city.
Beneath the veneer of a charming thief lies a jungle warrior, forged in defiance and bound by a solemn oath.
A deadly game of reflections unfolds; one man’s deception becomes another's reckoning – the mountains hold the key.

title: Businessman
overview: An ambitious young man arrives in Mumbai with the goal of becoming the city's most powerful mafia don.
hints: The rain-slicked streets of Mumbai reflect a hunger for dominion, a shadow clinging to a polished ambition.
He walks a tightrope of loyalty and deception, the scent of sandalwood mixing with the grit of the docks.
A forgotten temple’s crumbling façade holds echoes of ancient pacts; a warrior's burden starts to form.
Crimson hues stain the asphalt beneath a roaring motorcycle, chasing a phantom in the city's labyrinth.
Steel and silk collide - a carefully constructed empire, built on shattered trust and the promise of gold.

title: Kushi
overview: Two college students with opposing personalities fall in love, but their egos and misunderstandings keep them apart.
hints: Beneath the sprawling neem trees, a restless spirit yearns for freedom, mirroring the rhythm of a forgotten song.
A clash of steel and silk, a warrior's pride battling a delicate heart – a duel of perspectives unfolds.
Across dusty roads and ancient temples, a shared laughter masks a growing chasm, fueled by unspoken desires.
The monsoon’s fury echoes the storm within, as two souls navigate a labyrinth of pride and a blossoming connection.
A mountain peak silhouetted against the dawn, reflecting the fragile balance between love and the shattering of dreams.

title: Tagore
overview: A professor forms a secret organization of his former students to systematically eliminate corrupt officials across the state.

“The dust of Kurnool whispers of forgotten promises, a disciplined hand prepares to rewrite history’s scars.”
“Beneath the weight of a temple bell’s toll, a fractured lineage hunts for retribution – steel against steel.”
“Across the Deccan Plateau, a lone motorcycle carries a reckoning; a jungle warrior’s adopted face hides a deadly purpose.”
“The scent of cardamom and betrayal hangs heavy in the air, as the final reckoning unfolds under a monsoon’s grey.”

title: Ye Maaya Chesave

title: Nuvve Kavali

hints: Crimson dust swirls across a forgotten temple, mirroring a heart fractured by unspoken desires and ancestral oaths.

The scent of jasmine and sandalwood hangs heavy, masking a betrayal whispered amongst ancient family traditions.
A fierce jungle warrior adopts a dual identity, haunted by a childhood promise beneath a torrential monsoon rain.

title: Kshana Kshanam

“The scent of jasmine and gunpowder hangs heavy – a relentless pursuit through ancient markets and forgotten temples.”

“A fierce jungle warrior adopts a dual identity, navigating a world of quiet defiance and a solitary, unexpected bloom.”

title: Kick

hints: Beneath the relentless Andhra sun, a restless spirit seeks the ultimate rush, a feverish dance with danger.
A double life forged amidst chaotic rallies and stolen glances – a man mirroring the city's vibrant pulse.
The scent of sandalwood and diesel hangs heavy, a lone figure navigating a labyrinth of debts and unexpected loyalties.
Across the shimmering expanse of the Ganges, a desperate journey unfolds, punctuated by daring maneuvers and hidden compassion.
A motorcycle screams across India, leading to a precarious rescue on a mountain’s unforgiving face - redemption’s price is steep.”

“He sought solace in the rhythm of a vintage motorcycle, a restless spirit chasing a fading mirage.”
“Beneath the weight of ancestral expectations, a quiet rebellion blooms, rooted in shared glances and unspoken truths.”
